name: Text Downloader
description: Downloads text stories from additional sites. Add new sites by extending TextDownloaderExtension.
author: binarygeek119

versions.changelog: Initial release: second downloader provider for text stories from additional sites.
Add support for daddyforbaby.blogspot.com, beltedgirls.com, newsexstory.com, gaydemon.com, deviantart.com, storiesonline.net, asstr-mirror.org, and nifty.org. Improve request headers.
